decisions.reason: NYU offers ED1 and ED2 plans (confirmed in CDS 2024-2025 Section C21), but the university does not publish ED applicant or admit counts. The C21 numeric fields are blank in the official CDS, and NYU's institutional research does not disclose ED admit rate separately.
UIUC does not offer Early Decision; admissions plans are Regular Decision and priority application deadlines only.
Rutgers University-New Brunswick does not offer Early Decision; only rolling/priority deadlines.

Tufts offers ED1 and ED2 (confirmed in CDS 2024-2025 Section C21), but leaves the ED applicant/admit count fields blank. Tufts has not reported ED admission data in its public CDS for the past six+ years.
University of Washington does not offer Early Decision; only a single Regular Decision deadline.
Purdue University does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
Ohio State University does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
University of Maryland, College Park does not offer Early Decision; offers Early Action and Regular Decision only.
University of Georgia does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.

Wake Forest offers ED1 and ED2 (confirmed in CDS 2024-2025 Section C21) but stopped publicly releasing ED applicant/admit counts beginning with the Class of 2025. The C21 number fields are blank in the public CDS and the university does not disclose ED admit rate.
Texas A&M University does not offer Early Decision; uses priority/regular application deadlines.
University of Minnesota, Twin Cities does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
Florida State University does not offer Early Decision; uses Early Action and Regular Decision.

Virginia Tech does not offer Early Decision for general undergraduate admission; only Early Action and Regular Decision. (A binding ED option existed historically only for Architecture and Industrial Design — not a university-wide ED program and no published ED admit rate.)

Pepperdine University does not publish verifiable acceptance rate data for any of its Early rounds. The 2024-2025 Common Data Set does not disclose ED applicant or admit counts. No public ED admit rate available.
University of Pittsburgh does not offer Early Decision; admissions are rolling/priority.
North Carolina State University does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
University of Massachusetts Amherst does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
Penn State University does not offer Early Decision; uses rolling admission with a priority/early action deadline.
Michigan State University does not offer Early Decision; uses rolling admission with an early action deadline.
University of Delaware does not offer Early Decision; admissions use Early Action and Regular Decision.
Stony Brook University does not offer Early Decision; admissions use rolling priority deadlines.
Clemson University does not offer Early Decision; admissions are Early Action and Regular Decision.
Indiana University Bloomington does not offer Early Decision; admissions are Early Action and Regular Decision.
SUNY Binghamton University does not offer Early Decision; admissions are Early Action and Regular Decision.
Gonzaga University does not offer Early Decision. For the 2024-2025 cycle Gonzaga uses only Early Action (non-binding) and Regular Decision (CDS 2024-25 Section C21 marks ED = No).
University of California, Riverside (and the entire UC system) does not offer Early Decision; all UC undergraduate applications use a single November application window.
University of California, Santa Cruz (and the entire UC system) does not offer Early Decision; all UC undergraduate applications use a single November application window.
University at Buffalo (SUNY) does not offer Early Decision; admissions are Early Action and Regular Decision.
Marquette University does not offer Early Decision. Per its 2024-2025 Common Data Set Section C21, ED = No; Marquette uses Early Action (non-binding) and Regular Decision only.
